Doucai-vs-wucai-vs-tiancai: four mutually incompatible structures coexist (parallel品种 in Xia Yanjing 2009/2016 and Gao Feng; inclusion 'doucai is one kind of wucai' in Tian Zibing; same-level doucai/tiancai as the two methods of qinghua jiacai in Tian Zibing; tiancai as one of Chen Wanli's five doucai techniques in Gao Feng); Gao Feng's boundary by proportion of overglaze colour resolves the first two but not tiancai

Doucai name: three etymologies (Nan Yao Biji 'cou qi quan ti', Tian Zibing 'shang xia dou he', Xia Yanjing 'zheng yan dou yan'); the date of Nan Yao Biji is given as Yongzheng reign or 'first seen in Kangxi-Yongzheng'
Overglaze firing temperature: three non-overlapping ranges (Gao Feng 600-900 C, Xia Yanjing 750-860 C, Tian Zibing fencai 700 C and wucai 800 C); no source reconciles them
Qinghua origin: four positions (Tang, Song, post-mid-Yuan) with three temperature ranges (1170-1210 C, 1200 C, 1300 C); Xia Yanjing 2016 calls it a problem 'never clarified'

Youlihong craft origin: three attributions (Tang Changsha, Jun purple-red glaze, Yuan Jingdezhen); the order of the three painting methods (line, baibai, tuhui) is internally inconsistent; 2009 writes Huang Jiu, 2016 writes Huang Maijiu

Underglaze colour origin: the disagreement is qualitative, not chronological - Xia Yanjing calls the Three Kingdoms wares 'simple dotting', Gao Feng calls the same class 'already invented'; Tang kilns are given as three different sets
Fencai starting point: three phrasings with different force (Zhao Nong 'developed', Tian Zibing 'began', Xia Yanjing 'created'); the arsenic opacifier in glass white is given only by Tian Zibing

Falangcai definition: three orientations (colour material, ware type, court-imperial object); two readings of 'Guyuexuan'; Zhao Nong's figure caption 'Zhuolang cai' is a graphic variant left uncorrected
Su-sancai: Tian Zibing dates it to Kangxi with yellow-green-purple, Xia Yanjing to Ming Zhengde with yellow-green-blue-purple; the negative definition 'no red' is never examined
Song ceramic decoration: Tian Zibing's four methods (carved, impressed, needle-pricked, painted) cannot be mapped onto Xia Yanjing's nine; whether 'painted flower' counts as decoration is unstated
Monochrome-glaze naming overlaps B.6.1: yingqing/tianbai/luanbai are glaze-surface effects here but read as ware categories in B.6.1's three-criteria framework; piaci, mise and huayou remain in B.6.1
Chihui: three candidate origins (Wenzhou, Zhangzhou, Shima) and a name given by the Japanese, i.e. an externally assigned name
Thin entries: seven KUs (hongyou, huangyou, tianbai, gu-cai, tian-cai, guangcai, chihui) rest on one or two sentences and can support naming only, not process reconstruction
Missing process parameters across all sources: glaze thickness, colourant formulae, glass-white ratio, firing curves, number of firings, yield rate
2224 KUs remain unmounted
notes: 本批新建 1 个 Topic（B.6.4 胎装饰、釉装饰与彩绘），挂载 36 个 KU，不新增 Theme。结构设计的四项判断：其一，Topic 名与原定方案不同——h23 manifest 登记的是「釉色、彩绘与瓷器类型」，读完 33 条术语与工序候选（术语 27、工序 6）与 16 件器物候选后，材料实际按「装饰施加在胎、釉、彩哪一层」分成三个技术时点，而非按釉色与彩绘两分；器形部分（辽瓷）按原计划转入 B.6.5，故改题「胎装饰、釉装饰与彩绘：瓷器装饰的三层技术」。其二，第一层框架是装饰施加位置三分，它直接解释了两套清单为何不能互相映射：田自秉的刻、印、绣、画四法把「画花」列在胎装饰向彩绘过渡的位置，夏燕靖的九法只收胎装饰，因而没有「画花」却必须补入珍珠地划花与春字纹。其三，第二层框架「失控—受控」把窑变与开片、釉里红的飞红与拔白写成同一技术的两种状态，而不是成功与失败的评语。其四，第三层框架是装饰品种的命名依据八型（呈色剂、督陶官姓氏、釉面视觉、感官评价、烧造机构、装饰工序、产销地、域外命名），与 B.6.3 的「地望／制度／姓氏传说／文献品第」四型形成对照：装饰品种的命名几乎不依赖地理，而依赖釉面效果与工序序列，这正是它无法形成稳定分类的原因。角色分配：名目一律 term_anchor（21 个），装饰工序 procedure（5 个），代表器物 representative_work（8 个），工序可与制胎分离的广彩与名由域外给定的赤绘标 boundary_case（2 个）。三项边界处置：辽瓷的核心内容是中原式与契丹式两类器形的对照，留 B.6.5；法华器为陶胎低温釉，与唐三彩、辽三彩、宋三彩及二次烧成法同留 B.5.4；五彩人物洗、珐琅彩竹菊鹌鹑瓶、铜官窑釉罐三条只有图注，挂载会制造空壳代表器物，本批不挂载。v1.14 归档由工作树 v1.14 内容反向重构并核对哈希（21651 字节，sha256:1c8e547f221ebd93e208216d78d97e575d58b2e542b24f3b317969e178c3def9，与 h23 apply-plan 记录逐字节一致）——因 h23 尚未 commit，git HEAD 仍是 v1.13，不能直接取 HEAD。relation 总数由 6622 增至 6694（36 Theme + 36 Topic），member_of 由 624 增至 696；隔离单元由 1367 降至 1347（36 个 KU 中 20 个原本已通过 claim 关系入图）。未新增 KU、claim、candidate 或来源字节，未改写 03基础书籍-md文档/ 与 02-sources/，未执行 commit 或 push。
